newsitem.title: TURKEY: Two dead in Turkish Mediterranean coast flood.
newsitem.headline: Two dead in Turkish Mediterranean coast flood.

text.p: Two people have died and one has gone missing in a violent storm on Turkey's southern Mediterranean coast, provincial officials said on Thursday.
The dead were found drowned in separate cars on a flooded road in the popular holiday province of Antalya on Wednesday night, the governor's office said in a statement.
Three small boats sank in Antalya city's harbour and 42 other boats were damaged, Anatolian news agency said.
